attributes.action: Mandate CCTV in care homes & private nurseries with access to legal guardians
attributes.additional_details:
Every year, reports emerge of abuse, neglect, and mistreatment in care settings. While the vast majority of care workers provide excellent care, a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check only shows known concerns at the time of employment, it cannot prevent future abuse.

This is particularly important for non-verbal children, autistic individuals, people with learning disabilities, and vulnerable adults who may be unable to report abuse or explain what has happened to them.
attributes.background: A DBS check cannot prevent abuse. Non-verbal children and vulnerable adults often cannot report harm. Make CCTV mandatory in care homes and private nurseries, with access for families when abuse, neglect, or malpractice is suspected.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/761111
